newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon reserves up $22 mln 1st half Aug.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon reserves up $22 mln 1st half Aug.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $22 million in the first half of August to $6.596 billion, according to central bank figures published in newspapers on Monday.
Gross reserves had risen by $23.33 million in the second half of July to $6.574 billion.
They include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.

The statement gave no figure for the bank's net reserves but banking sources said net reserves dropped by $350 million to $4.6 billion in mid-August from $4.95 billion in mid-July. However, a central bank official denied reserves had dropped that amount, saying "This is nonsense."
The central bank's net reserves stood at $4.015 billion at the end of 1996 compared with $2.858 billion a year earlier.
